'''Bao Zhenmin''' ({{zh|c=包振民|p=Bāo Zhèngmín}}; born 27 December 1961) is a Chinese marine biologist who is dean of the Marine Life Sciences School, [[Ocean University of China]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].<ref name="apple">{{cite news|url=https://www.cae.cn/cae/html/main/colys/30803427.html |script-title=zh:包振民 |work=cae.cn |date=2017 |access-date=26 September 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Bao was born in [[Yantai]], [[Shandong]], on 27 December 1961.<ref name="apple"/> After high school, he studied, then taught, at what is now the [[Ocean University of China]].<ref name="apple"/><ref>{{cite news|author1=Liu Yanjie ({{lang|zh|刘艳杰}})|author2=Feng Wenbo ({{lang|zh|冯文波}})|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2020/6/441787.shtm |script-title=zh:包振民院士：保持初心 丹心报国——中国海洋大学海洋生命学院院长包振民的科研人生 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=22 June 2020 |access-date=26 September 2021 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1997, he earned his doctor's degree in [[aquaculture science]] from Qingdao University of Oceanology (now Ocean University of China).<ref name="apple"/> In December 1997, he became deputy dean of the Marine Life Sciences School, Ocean University of China, rising to dean in 2011. 

== Honours and awards ==
* 2001 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class) 
* 2008 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class) 
* 2015 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class) 
* 27 November 2017 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)<ref>{{cite news|editor1=Ding Xiao ({{lang|zh|丁晓}})|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_1880916 |script-title=zh:中国工程院产生67位新当选院士，比尔·盖茨当选外籍院士 |work=thepaper |date=27 November 2017 |access-date=26 September 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 2018 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class)
